board.name: Notability
board.content:
We’re best known for Notability - an industry-leading app that brings the expressivity of paper to the digital world. Our mission is to help people learn, think, and collaborate more effectively.

 

For over fifteen years, our growing team has designed intuitive software used by millions around the world. We think deeply about users’ needs and believe the best ideas can come from anywhere. That mindset shapes both our products and our company: we value clear thinking, great design, and thoughtful collaboration.

 

We’re profitable, proudly independent (no outside investors), and based in downtown San Francisco. Our hybrid work policy supports flexibility, and we actively promote work-life balance. We offer competitive compensation, generous benefits, and a culture where people are trusted to do their best work - without burnout.
